title: WASD MC
description: A community-driven Eco Anarchy Minecraft server with Practice PvP, a player-driven economy, custom features, seasonal events, and an active Discord community.
body: WASD MC is a community based Minecraft server featuring Eco Anarchy and Practice. Build your fortune, fight other players, form alliances, control the economy and compete in seasonal events. With a lively Discord community, regular updates and unique features, there's always something to do. Sign up now and make your mark!
